summary: Retested the LoginModal 401 interceptor guard fix from iteration_6. All 5 required scenarios PASS: (1) wrong-cred submissions from header-login-btn, hero-portal-btn and footer-login-btn all keep URL on /, keep the LoginModal open, show an 'Invalid credentials' toast, and do NOT set te_token. (2) After typing the correct password Ranjita@1985 the login succeeds and navigates to /dashboard with te_token set. (3) Regression: setting te_token='invalid.token.here' and visiting /invoices still hard-redirects to /login (session-expiry path intact for non-login endpoints). (4) Regression: /login page with wrong creds shows 'Invalid credentials' toast in place, no redirect loop, no token stored. The interceptor guard `if (url.endsWith('/auth/login')) return Promise.reject(err)` works universally.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor url check uses endsWith('/auth/login') which is safe here because axios config.url is the relative path against baseURL /api; any future rename of the login endpoint needs the guard updated in tandem.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_7 verified the axios 401 interceptor exemption for /auth/login. Landing LoginModal (header/hero/footer entry points), standalone /login page, and expired-token protected-route redirect all behave correctly. Backend unchanged since iteration_6.
